name: india-gov-blockchain-projects
title: Blockchain in Indian Government Administration: A Project-Level Dataset (2017–2026)
description: Coded, source-linked inventory of blockchain / distributed-ledger initiatives by Indian public bodies (Union, all 28 States and 8 Union Territories, regulators, courts, statutory bodies), with dated lifecycle events, source-reported challenges (TOE-coded), evidence scores and a time series of the NIC blockchain platform. Structured as normalised tables with controlled vocabularies so new projects, events and snapshots can be added and validated.

sources.title: See sources.csv (339 public sources: PIB, NIC, MeitY, State portals, courts, news)
